target.question: Which parts of the proposed onboarding redesign are necessary for users to complete activation, and what interactions prevent a simple feature ranking?

native_baseline.target_task: Which parts of the proposed onboarding redesign are necessary for users to complete activation, and what interactions prevent a simple feature ranking?
native_baseline.reference_practitioner: Product manager specializing in onboarding discovery and usability studies, without formal program-reduction training.
ordinary_methods: Decompose proposals into user needs, flows, assumptions and dependencies.
Run usability sessions with prototypes and compare activation funnels or staged variants.
Use qualitative failure observations and small experiments to prioritize changes.
ordinary_evidence: Interview notes, prototype task completion, funnel events, feature dependencies and observed user errors.
uncertainty: Scoped authored hypothesis, not verified practitioner consensus.
Practices vary; formal minimality searches and routing inversions are not assumed routine.

facts: Authored synthetic environment; no real persons or organizations.

A deterministic onboarding replay is calibrated against the fixed activation task. Each permitted rule subset is executable and resets completely; one trial returns pass/fail for activation. This is not a model of population-wide user necessity.

Eight executable revisions form a nested history. Independent certification establishes repeatability and exactly one pass-to-fail transition on this chain, without disclosing its location. Revision 0 passes; revision 7 fails.
Rules A-G are separable toggles. A is welcome copy, B an identity prerequisite, C a theme, D a navigation guard, E a tooltip, F an optional survey, G a confirmation banner.
Plausible explanations include copy confusion, either guard alone, and interactions. Existing replay traces show a guard wait but do not identify its cause.
initial_observations: Current replay cannot reach activation; deciding which proposal parts require joint investigation remains open.
known_uncertainties: Replay minimality, revision association and real-user necessity are different claims.
available_affordances: inspect existing traces and revision manifests
constraints: No new participant study; no changing the replay success criterion.

other_constraints: Both branches start from an independent reset of this same world.
A procedure may contain elementary trials, but all consume the common ledger.
Unused resources are allowed; proposed later inquiries are not performed within this budget.
